q: The film / We / Twenty years / Seeing / To see / The rich / What he needs / It took …
a: 依次：名词短语；代词；数量名词短语；动名词；不定式；the＋形容词名词化；主语从句；形式主语 it。
why: 词性或结构形式与句子成分分开回答。Twenty years 是整体时间段，所以配 is；最后一句真正主语是 to make them into a film。
note: The rich 不能只记成普通名词；应记住 the＋形容词表示一类人。

q: 情态动词、助动词和系动词怎样构成谓语？
a: can do；is doing；has done；was done；is happy。
why: 情态动词后接动词原形，不是 to do；谓语必须整体识别，不能只圈 has、will、is。系动词＋表语是学校语法中的复合谓语结构。
note: 照片中情态动词例式写成“can/must/should …＋to do”，应去掉 to。

q: an American / yours / cold / exciting / up / to teach English / on the wall / that he has never been abroad
a: 名词短语；名词性物主代词；形容词；形容词化的 -ing 形式；副词；不定式短语；介词短语；表语从句。
why: The sun is up 中 up 不是动词；His job is to teach English 中 to teach English 不是介词短语。判断表语先找系动词。
note: up 的手写分类为 v.，应改为副词；其余按原图核对。

q: his homework / me / five / the old / listening to popular music / not to see me / what he said
a: 名词短语；代词；数词（省略所指数名词）；名词化结构；动名词短语；不定式短语；宾语从句。
why: enjoy 后接 doing；pretend 后接 to do。非谓语短语能作宾语，但不会因此变成谓语。
note: 说明答案，不用字迹不清的缩写推算错误数。

q: He gave me a pen. / He bought Alice a gift.
a: me / Alice 是间接宾语；a pen / a gift 是直接宾语。
why: 可改为 gave a pen to me、bought a gift for Alice。间接宾语常是接受者，直接宾语是给予或购买的事物。
note: 照片中两句的直接宾语、间接宾语标注互换。

q: asked me to help / found him standing / made himself heard / made him captain / keep the room clean
a: to help：不定式；standing：现在分词；heard：过去分词；captain：名词；clean：形容词。
why: 宾语与补语有逻辑主谓关系：he was standing；he is captain；the room is clean。双宾语不是这种关系。
note: 讲义空白属于知识点待补，不算错题。

q: English / our / third / international / over there / with a baby in her arms / playing basketball / planted last year / to do / that I do
a: English：表语言/学科的名词性修饰语（教材分类也可能视为形容词）；our：物主限定词；third：序数词；international：形容词；over there：副词短语；with…：介词短语；playing…：现在分词短语；planted…：过去分词短语；to do：不定式；that I do：定语从句。
why: with a baby in her arms 没有独立的限定谓语，不是从句。playing / planted 分别体现主动、被动关系，不能只写 n. 或 v. 代替结构分类。
note: with…、playing…、planted… 的分类需要回收；English 不作机械唯一词性判错。

q: In the classroom / asking for a pen / to do his homework
a: 介词短语（地点）；现在分词短语（伴随）；不定式短语（按讲义意图为目的）。
why: 题目若问“形式”，答介词短语、分词短语、不定式；若问“意义”，才答地点、伴随、目的。最后一句也可能把 to do… 理解成修饰 pen，需结合命题意图。
note: 避免把“地点”和“介词短语”混成同一种分类。

q: He came. / I saw her. / I gave her a book. / She looks young. / We call him a wise man.
why: 先看动词是否及物或系动，再判断后面两个成分是两项宾语，还是“宾语＋对它的说明”。a wise man 说明 him 的身份。

q: and / but, yet / for, so / or, either…or
a: 并列或递进；转折；因果；选择或“否则”。
why: 并列句要有两个分句，不能只数 and。still 通常是连接性副词，正式写作中连接独立分句宜用分号或另加连词，不宜照搬逗号拼接。
note: 讲义 She tried again and again, still… 的标点不宜作为规范写作范例。

q: My brother hasn’t done his homework.
why: hasn’t done 是完整谓语；回答“做了什么”的是 his homework。

q: People all over the world speak English.
why: all over the world 修饰 people；speak 后的 English 是宾语。

q: How many new words did you learn last class?
why: 还原为 You learned how many new words。宾语虽移到句首，仍是完整名词短语，不能只划 words。

q: Some of the students in the school want to go swimming, how about you?
why: 不能只划 swimming；go swimming 是活动表达。原句逗号后另起问句，规范可写 “…want to go swimming. How about you?”
note: 照片只划了 swimming，范围不足。

q: The old man was feeling very tired.
why: was feeling 是系动词 feel 的过去进行形式；very tired 整体说明主语状态。不能把 feeling 一起划入表语。
note: 照片把 feeling very tired 整段划出，混入了系动词。

q: The leaves have turned yellow.
why: have turned 表示已经变得，yellow 说明变化后的状态。
note: 可见划线为 yellow。

q: Soon they all became interested in the subject.
why: 核心词 interested，完整表语短语为 interested in the subject。became 是系动词，Soon 是时间状语。
note: 只划 interested 时需区分“核心词”与“完整成分”。

q: What is your given name?
why: given name 指名字；your 限定归属，given 修饰 name。若题目只要求修饰性定语，核心是 given。

q: I am afraid some people forgot to sweep the floor.
why: to sweep the floor 是 forgot 的宾语，不是定语；am afraid 后接省略 that 的从句。
note: 照片把 to sweep the floor 划作定语。

q: The man downstairs was trying to sleep.
why: 副词 downstairs 后置修饰 man；不是一看副词就认定为状语。
note: 可见划线为 downstairs。

q: I am waiting for the sound of the other shoe!
a: of the other shoe 修饰 sound；other 在内部修饰 shoe。
why: 要分层看：sound 后接介词短语定语；介词短语内部仍可有定语。
note: 照片只划 the other，漏了修饰 sound 的完整短语。

q: She likes the children to read newspapers and books in the reading-room.
a: to read newspapers and books in the reading-room
why: 在此句式中，the children 是宾语，不定式说明希望孩子做什么。短语内 newspapers and books 是 read 的宾语。
note: 原句表达不如 would like 自然，但可据 likes sb to do 分析。

q: He asked her to take the boy out of school.
a: to take the boy out of school
why: ask sb to do sth；her 是宾语，后面的不定式是宾补。
note: 划线范围与题意一致。

q: She found it difficult to do the work.
why: it 是形式宾语，to do the work 是真正宾语；difficult 才是宾补。可理解为 She found doing the work difficult。
note: 照片划的是 to do the work，混淆真正宾语和宾补。

q: They call me Lily sometimes.
why: me 与 Lily 指同一人，Lily 给 me 命名；不是两个宾语。sometimes 是状语。
note: 可见划线为 Lily。

q: There was a big smile on her face.
a: on her face（按讲义的地点状语分析）
why: 存在句表示何处有某物；也有分析把该介词短语并入 smile 的后置修饰语，本讲义按地点状语处理。
note: 不要把此题当成唯一语法分析体系的判别题。

q: Every night he heard the noise upstairs.
a: Every night；upstairs 的依附关系需结合语境。
why: Every night 明确是时间状语。upstairs 可描述听到声音的位置，也可后置修饰 noise（楼上的噪声）；孤立句存在歧义。
note: 不能据 upstairs 的单一划法判定掌握程度。

q: He began to learn English when he was eleven.
why: 时间状语从句修饰 began to learn；to learn English 是 began 的宾语。

q: The man on the motorbike was traveling too fast.
why: on the motorbike 修饰 man，是定语；too fast 修饰 was traveling，是状语。
note: 可见划线为 too fast。

q: You will tell your friend that you’ve got to school.
a: You 主语；will tell 谓语；your friend 间接宾语；that…school 直接宾语从句。
why: tell sb sth：两项宾语。“你已到校”是告知的内容；从句内 you 是主语，have got 是谓语，to school 是地点/方向成分。
note: 原文 you’ve got to school 按“已经到校”理解，不误解为 have got to do。

q: But as the moon gave far too much light, I didn’t dare open a window.
a: 主句：I／didn’t dare open／a window；as 从句作原因状语。
why: 从句内 the moon 是主语，gave 是谓语，far too much light 是宾语。But 是衔接上文的连词，不属于主语。

q: Another time five months ago, I happened to be upstairs at dusk when the window was open.
a: I 主语；happened to be 表示“碰巧处于”；upstairs 地点成分；Another time five months ago、at dusk、when…open 为时间信息。
why: when 从句内部 window 主语、was 系动词、open 表语。happened to be 不要拆成互不相关的两个谓语；upstairs 在不同学校分析体系中可列作 be 的表语。
note: 明确层级即可，不据“表语/地点成分”的体系差异判错。

q: The dark, rainy evening, the wind, and the thundering clouds held me entirely in their power.
a: 并列主语：evening、wind、clouds 三个名词短语；held 谓语；me 宾语；entirely 状语；in their power 为宾语的状态补足成分。
why: “把我控制在它们力量之下”可还原 me in their power。dark / rainy / thundering 在名词短语内作定语。
note: 不能只划 evening、wind 而漏掉主语中的修饰语。

q: We often study Chinese history on Friday afternoon.
why: 只有一个限定谓语 study；时间状语不会增加分句。
note: 照片标“简”。

q: The boy who offered me his seat is called Tom.
why: 主句谓语 is called；who offered… 是修饰 boy 的定语从句。
note: 照片标“复”。

q: There is a chair in this room, isn’t there?
a: 简单句＋附加问句（按本练习分类选简单句）
why: 附加问句不按普通并列分句计入该题的三分类。
note: 照片标“简”。

q: My brother and I go to school at half past seven in the morning and come back home at seven in the evening.
why: My brother and I 是并列主语；go 与 come back 是同一主语下的并列谓语，没有新从句。
note: 照片标“复”。不能凭两个 and 判为复合句。

q: He is in class one and I am in class two.
why: and 连接 He is… 和 I am… 两个完整分句。
note: 照片标“并”。

q: He was fond of drawing when he was yet a child.
why: when 引导时间状语从句。drawing 是动名词，不是独立谓语。
note: 照片标“复”。

q: Neither has he changed his mind, nor will he do so.
why: neither…nor 连接两个分句，否定词前置触发部分倒装。
note: 照片标“并”。

q: What he said at the meeting is very important, isn’t it?
why: What he said… 整体是主语从句；主句谓语 is。
note: 照片标“复”。

q: The farmer is showing the boy how to plant a tree.
why: how to plant a tree 是“疑问词＋不定式”，不是有独立限定谓语的从句；整体作所展示的内容。
note: 照片标“复”；需与 how he can plant a tree 对比。

q: Both Tom and Jack enjoy country music.
why: both…and 只连接主语 Tom 和 Jack；全句一个谓语 enjoy。
note: 照片标“简”。

q: The development of science and technology has made great influence on people’s daily life and work.
a: 主语 The development of science and technology；谓语 has made；宾语 great influence；on… 是 influence 的补足修饰成分，通常随名词短语分析。
why: 主语中心词是 development，不是 technology。原句搭配不地道，标准表达建议 has had a great influence on…。不把原文搭配问题算到学生头上。
note: 原题 make influence 及介词短语划法不宜机械评分。

q: That is why the people all over the world are making great efforts to keep the natural balance.
a: That 主语；is 系动词；why…balance 整体为表语从句。
why: 从句内 people 主语、are making 谓语、great efforts 宾语。to keep… 表目的/补足 efforts 的内容，不是“宾语会保持平衡”的宾补。
note: 照片把 to keep… 标“宾补”；更重要的是补标整个 why 从句的表语功能。

q: Effective measures can be taken to make communication easier between people from different cultures.
a: 主语 Effective measures；谓语 can be taken；目的状语 to make…cultures。
why: 不定式内部 communication 是 make 的宾语，easier 是宾补；between… 修饰交流范围；from different cultures 修饰 people。目的不定式不是被动谓语 taken 的直接宾语。
note: 照片把 to make… 整段标作宾语。

q: It occurred to Jack, the English monitor that he had forgotten to take his English textbook with me.
a: It 形式主语；occurred 谓语；to Jack 介词短语；the English monitor 同位语；that… 真正主语从句。
why: It occurs to sb that… 表“某人想到……”。that 从句不修饰 monitor，因此不是定语从句。原句建议在 monitor 后补逗号，并核实 with me 是否应为 with him。
note: 照片把 that… 标定语；原讲义标点和代词也有瑕疵。

q: I must make full use of the limited time left to me and do as much as I can for the living people.
a: I 主语；must make…与（must）do… 为并列谓语结构；left to me 是 time 的后置定语。
why: make full use of 是固定搭配；as much as I can 表可做到的事情/数量；for the living people 表受益对象，不是宾补。
note: 照片将 for the living people 标“宾补”；应重新判断逻辑关系。

q: The boy, who was just released from the prison life, was caught stealing again.
a: The boy 主语；who…life 定语从句；was caught 谓语；stealing 主语补足成分；again 状语。
why: 主动形式是 someone caught the boy stealing；变被动后 stealing 补充主语 boy，不再是主句宾语。原文 prison life 表达生硬，不作为写作范例。
note: 照片把 stealing 作为宾语，需结合被动结构重看。

q: He was interested in creating a picture of the world, a digital time capsule for the future.
a: He 主语；was 系动词；interested in creating… 表语；a digital time capsule… 为 a picture… 的同位语。
why: 介词 in 后 creating… 是动名词短语；同位语用另一个名词短语解释同一事物，不是宾补。
note: 照片把 a digital time capsule… 标“宾补”。

q: On this theory, narcissism becomes a problem only when certain early experiences, like a lack of parental empathy, make you cling to the centre-of-the-universe fantasy into her life.
a: 主句 narcissism / becomes / a problem；On this theory 状语；only when… 时间/条件状语从句。
why: 从句内 experiences 主语、make 谓语、you 宾语、cling… 宾补。like a lack… 举例说明 experiences。原句 you 与 her 等表达衔接异常，末尾不作可靠精细判分依据。
note: 保留原句，不静默改写有问题的材料。

q: And with the high amount of people who come unprepared for such an active hike, Norway’s leading hiking group Friluftsliv, also has called for regulations on the number of tourists hiking to Trolltunga.
a: 主语 Norway’s leading hiking group Friluftsliv；谓语 has called for；regulations 宾语；句首 with… 作背景/原因状语。
why: who… 修饰 people；on the number… 修饰 regulations；hiking to Trolltunga 修饰 tourists。主语后的逗号不规范，amount of people 宜改 number of people。
note: 照片把句首 people 当主语，末尾 on… 当状语；先抓主句 has called for。

q: When the person using the fork starts to slurp, the fork sends a signal to the person’s phone, making it play a sound to mask the slurping noise.
a: when… 为时间状语从句；主句 the fork / sends / a signal；making… 为结果状语。
why: using the fork 修饰 person；making 短语内 it 是宾语、play… 是宾补，to mask… 是目的状语。
note: 可见对 using… 定语、making… 状语的判断方向正确。

q: Monsters, dogs and deaths are the things most people fear.
a: Monsters, dogs and deaths 并列主语；are 系动词；the things most people fear 表语。
why: most people fear 是省略 that/which 的定语从句，修饰 things；从句中 fear 缺宾语。

q: It took Macdonald and a team of researchers seven weeks to make them into a film.
a: It 形式主语；took 谓语；Macdonald and a team of researchers 为人称宾语；seven weeks 表所需时间；to make… 真正主语。
why: It takes sb some time to do… 是形式主语句式，to make… 不是目的状语。take 后具体成分名称各教材略有差异，本题重点是 it 与真正主语的对应。

q: In one short scene an American girl is playing with her hula hoop.
a: In one short scene 状语；an American girl 主语；is playing 谓语；with her hula hoop 介词短语。
why: play with… 中 with 后的名词短语是介词宾语，不能直接当作 play 的直接宾语。

q: The film ends just before midnight, with a young woman in her car.
a: The film 主语；ends 谓语；just before midnight 时间状语；with… 为伴随背景。
why: ends 在此不及物。with 结构内部 a young woman 与 in her car 有逻辑主谓关系。

q: You will find senior high school different from junior high school.
a: You 主语；will find 谓语；senior high school 宾语；different from junior high school 宾补。
why: 不同的是 senior high school；因此 different… 描写宾语，不是修饰 find 的状语。

q: Athletes have long compared retirement to death, but N.B.A. stars never really fade away.
a: but 连接两个分句；前句 Athletes / have compared / retirement；后句 N.B.A. stars / fade away。
why: have 只是助动词，前句完整谓语是 have compared；long、never、really 为状语。to death 是 compare…to… 的比较对象成分。
note: 照片只圈 have，漏了 compared。

q: The ability of bats to coexist with viruses that can spill over to other animals, in particular humans, can have devastating markets and invade their territory.
a: 可确定主语核心 ability；主句谓语 can have… and invade…；that…humans 修饰 viruses。
why: to coexist… 说明 ability 的内容，不是限定谓语。原文 devastating markets / invade their territory 语义搭配异常，不宜直接视为正常范句，更不应擅改成 impacts 再评分。
note: 此题保留结构提示，完整句意暂不判分。

q: Animals have limited food and water resources and little shelter from predators, predators that could cause further mortality in the weeks and months after smoke of fires clear.
a: Animals 主语；have 谓语；limited food and water resources 与 little shelter… 并列宾语。
why: 重复的 predators 可按解释性同位结构理解，that… 修饰它；after… 是内部时间从句。原文 smoke…clear 存在主谓搭配问题。
note: 首层结构可讲解，句末原题问题不计学生错误。

q: Such work will help build a more complete picture of wildfire impacts and will better inform the conservation measures needed to prevent the astonishing scenes of recent weeks from becoming the new normal.
a: Such work 主语；will help 与 will inform 为并列谓语；needed… 后置修饰 measures。
why: build… 依附 help，完整词组 help (to) do；prevent…from doing 为固定结构。needed 没有独立的时态，不是第三个主句谓语。

q: Apples, as the two researchers observed, came to be associated with important people and places in American slang by the turn of the 20th century.
a: Apples 主语；came to be associated… 为谓语结构；as…observed 为插入性的非限制性从句；in…、by… 为状语。
why: be associated with 表“与……有关”；by the turn… 给出时间范围。不要把 researchers 当主句主语。

q: Life in a Day is a film about everyday lives of people in different countries.
why: 主语是影片名；is 为系动词，a film… 为表语。长定语不改变基本句型。

q: The director Kevin Macdonald created a picture of the world as a digital time capsule for the future.
why: The director Kevin Macdonald 为主语，created 为谓语，a picture… 为宾语。as a digital time capsule 表用途/身份说明。

q: He asked people around the world to film a short video for their daily routines on a typical day.
why: He / asked / people around the world / to film…；不定式为宾补。

q: Then he and his team turned them into a film.
a: 本讲义五句型框架常按 SVO；into a film 是必需的结果补足成分。
why: 更细语法体系可分析为 SVO＋结果补足语（或 SVOA/SVOC）。理解“把它们变成影片”比死认一个缩写重要。
note: 照片写 SVO，不据体系差异判错。

q: The scenes are well connected.
a: 按“被连接起来”的动作理解为被动结构；按“衔接紧密”的状态理解可记 SVP。
why: connected 可为被动分词，也可形容词化。该句缺少上下文，不能把 SVP 或被动分析其中之一机械判错。
note: 照片写 SVP，是可解释的状态读法。

q: The film sends people a clear message.
why: people 是间接宾语，a clear message 是直接宾语。两者不指同一事物。

q: Although people around the world are living different lives, they all try to find meanings in those everyday routines.
a: 主句按 SVO：they / try / to find meanings…；全句是复合句。
why: 五种基本句型描述主干；简单/并列/复合描述分句组合，两种分类可同时成立。
note: 不能把“主句 SVO”理解成“全句是简单句”。

q: Tom is a successful businessman. He hires a lot of people to help him.
a: Tom is a successful businessman, and he hires a lot of people to help him.
why: 两句顺承陈述，用 and；两个分句各有主语和谓语。

q: You’d better go to the opening ceremony of the Film Festival by taxi. You will be late.
a: You’d better go to the opening ceremony of the Film Festival by taxi, or you will be late.
why: or 表“否则”，不是让人从两件事中随便选。

q: They didn’t like him at first. They ended up singing his praises.
a: They didn’t like him at first, but they ended up singing his praises.
why: 前后态度相反，用 but 表转折。

q: He finished a difficult task on his own soon after he entered the company. His colleagues looked at him differently.
a: He finished a difficult task on his own soon after he entered the company, so his colleagues looked at him differently.
why: so 表结果。前一分句自身含 after 从句，因此严格说合并后是“并列复合句”，原题把它统称并列句是简化。
note: 学生用 so 合理；指出题目术语简化，不算学生错误。

q: I am not free this afternoon. I have made an appointment with my dentist.
a: I am not free this afternoon, for I have made an appointment with my dentist.
why: 题目要求并列连词，for 可以解释前句原因。because 也能表达正确意思，但组成的是主从复合句。
note: 照片使用 because；问题是未满足题型要求，不是 because 本身不合语法。

q: Flight Canada A302 ___ at 16:30. / The more you ___, the fatter… / as soon as he ___ me
why: 时刻表用一般现在时；条件/时间从句表示将来时通常用现在时。eat 的主语 you；calls 的主语 he。
note: 本卡归纳第11页三处例句填空。

q: He ___ a telephone call now. / We ___ some teaching material these months. / He ___ freely in class. / We ___ for Nanjing this month.
a: is answering；are writing；is always talking；are leaving
why: now 表当前；these months 表阶段性活动；always＋进行时可带情绪；are leaving 表已安排的将来。
note: 进行时不只表示说话这一秒正在发生。

q: Paul, you ___ (always buy) rubbers. How many rubbers do you use every day?
why: 后句语气暗示说话人对反复购买感到惊讶；always＋现在进行时带主观色彩。普通习惯也可用一般现在时，但此题意在考进行体。
note: 可见作答 are always buying。

q: We will start as soon as the manager ___ (come).
why: as soon as 引导时间状语从句；主句将来，从句一般现在；manager 单数。

q: According to the time table, the train for Shanghai ___ (leave) at 8:00 a.m.
why: 按固定时刻表安排，用一般现在时。

q: He ___ (come) to see us tomorrow.
why: 进行时可表已安排的来访；tomorrow 不意味着只能用 will。孤立句没有强制唯一的将来形式。
note: 照片 is coming 合理。

q: He ___ (walk) to school now as his bike has gone wrong.
why: 自行车坏了，所以最近暂时改步行；now 可表示当前阶段。

q: He ___ (be) a science teacher years ago. / Last night I ___ (give) a lecture.
why: years ago、last night 明确把事件放在已经结束的过去时间。give 的过去式是 gave。

q: Mr. Smith ___ the book for 3 weeks. / So far there ___ no news. / People’s life ___ in the past few years. / Up to now, the work ___ very busy.
why: for…、so far、in the past…、up to now 都可把过去联系到现在。news 不可数，the work 在原文中为单数；最后一例用“work is busy”不自然，宜作时态形式说明而非仿写。

q: Since he ___ (graduate), he ___ (not visit) his alma mater. / This is the first time that I ___ (be) to Thailand.
why: since 引出过去起点，主句概括此后至今；This is the first time 后常用现在完成时。

q: 他刚刚咽气。
why: 强调刚发生且与现在有关，has＋过去分词 died。不能用 dead 代替 died；dead 是形容词。
note: 放大后可见作答 has just died，不记成错误。

q: 他死了有三年了。
a: He has been dead for three years.
why: die 为瞬间变化，不能直接描述持续三年的过程；be dead 为持续状态。

q: He has become a doctor. → He has ___ a doctor for a year.
why: 从“成为”转为“处于医生身份”；been 是 be 的过去分词。

q: He has joined the army. → He has ___ the army for a year.
why: join 表加入瞬间；be in 表在军队中服役的持续状态。

q: He has died. → He has ___ for a year.
why: died 是动作，dead 是状态；完成时需 has been dead。

q: He has left. → He has ___ for a year.
why: leave 表离开，be away 表不在的状态。

q: He has married. → He has ___ for a year.
why: 结婚这一变化对应婚姻状态 be married。

q: He has borrowed the book. → He has ___ the book for a week.
why: borrow 指借入瞬间；keep 表持有一段时间。

q: He has bought the car. → He has ___ the car for a week.
why: buy 指买入；have 指拥有；has had 为现在完成时。
note: 放大照片后可见该题写的是 had；上次把它说成 kept 是误读，本版已撤销这条错题判断。

q: He has come. → He has ___ for a week.
why: 从“来到”改为“在这里”。

q: The film has begun. → The film has ___ for a moment.
why: be on 表正在上映/进行。

q: He has fallen ill. → He has ___ ill for a week.
why: fall ill 表生病的变化，be ill 表持续生病。

q: He has returned. → He has ___ for a moment.
why: return 表回来这一动作；be back 表已回来的状态。

q: Martin, if you do well in the test, I ___ take you to the zoo.
why: 主句表达承诺；if 从句使用一般现在时。

q: The dark clouds are gathering. It ___ rain.
why: 乌云是当前可见的预测依据，be going to 符合语境。

q: Please fasten your seat belt. The plane ___ take off soon.
a: is about to（也可 is going to / will）
why: 系安全带说明即将起飞；about to 强调迫近，soon 可以与其语义相容。原题无选项，不能排除其他合理将来表达。

q: You ___ (not) play with fire.
a: are not to（也可 must not）
why: be to 可表示命令或规定；否定表示禁止。此处不是时态变形错误。
note: 照片 are not to 可以接受。

q: Tomorrow is Saturday. I ___ see the movie with my friends.
why: 表达计划或意图；am going to 与 I 搭配。

q: The highway ___ be completed in July.
a: is to（也可 will / is going to）
why: be to 表计划；be completed 是被动；将来形式不唯一。

q: The sun ___ brightly when we climbed… / We ___ an exam at this time yesterday.
why: 过去参照时刻正在进行的背景动作；sun 单数、we 复数。

q: I ___ 5000 words before I entered… / By the end of last year, we ___ five houses. / …because we ___ interest.
why: 均先确立过去参照点，再向前看已完成的动作。loss 的动词是 lose，过去分词 lost。

q: By noon we ___ about twenty miles. / It ___ for a week by Tuesday. / That was the first time that I…
a: had walked；had snowed；had been informed of the changes of the meeting
why: 这里 noon、Tuesday 均按过去语境解释。That was the first time 对应过去完成时；“被告知”需被动。
note: 脱离过去上下文，by noon 自身不限定一定用过去完成时。

q: When I got back, they ___ (pull) down most of the houses in the street.
why: 拆除发生在我回来之前；got back 是过去参照点。

q: John and I ___ (share) the drive as it is a long journey.
a: will share（也可 are going to share）
why: 旅途很长，因此安排轮流驾驶。没有更多语境时，一般现在时描述惯常分工也可能，但本讲义意在考将来安排。
note: 放大照片可见 will share。

q: Since you ___ (learn) the rules, you can correct these grammatical mistakes by yourselves.
why: since 此处表示“既然”，不是时间起点；已掌握规则使现在能改错。

q: Why ___ the man ___ (stand) in the middle of the road? ___ he ___ (try) to get across?
why: 在询问眼前正在发生的动作，两处均用现在进行时。

q: When I entered his office, he ___ (try) to fix a TV set.
why: entered 是过去时刻，维修尝试是当时正在发生的背景。

q: He will not go out until the doctor ___ (give) his permission.
why: until 时间从句表示将来时通常用一般现在时，doctor 单数。

q: When the noise ___ (die) down, the schoolmaster began her speech.
why: 强调噪声先平息再讲话可用过去完成；when 已交代顺序时一般过去时也自然。

q: Mr. Pitt just telephoned to say that he ___ (not come) back until Saturday night.
a: was not coming（或 would not come）
why: 从过去的 telephoned 向后看计划；过去进行时可表示当时的将来安排。

q: Peter ___ (hurt) his ankle, but it’s better now.
why: 受伤发生在过去，现在已好些；hurt 的原形、过去式、过去分词同形。

q: I ___ (hope) to take a good holiday this year but I wasn’t able to get away.
why: had hoped 突出后来未实现的原先打算；hoped 只是过去希望，也可与后句组成自然叙述。
note: 照片 hoped 不宜直接判语法错误；若考指定知识点，推荐 had hoped。

q: We ___ no sooner ___ (seat) than the bus ___ (start).
why: no sooner…than 常用“过去完成＋一般过去”；人是被安排就座或处于就座状态，需 been seated。
note: 需核实手写 seated 的词尾 d，不因照片字迹直接判错。

q: Since he ___ (graduate), he ___ (not visit) his alma mater.
why: since 从句给出过去起点；主句说明从那时到现在没有发生的事。

q: That is the first time that I ___ (inform) of the changes of the meeting.
why: 现在的首次经历＋我被通知：现在完成被动。have 与 I 一致。

q: I ___ (paint) the house the whole morning. / Jimmy ___ (do) homework for two hours, but…hasn’t finished it.
why: 强调从过去持续到现在的活动及当前痕迹；不能因为 for two hours 就忽略进行性。

q: By the time he comes back, I ___ (finish)… / We ___ (learn) 3000 words by the end of next term.
a: will have finished；will have learned / learnt
why: 以将来某时为参照，届时已经完成；by the time 从句仍用 comes。

q: —What’s the matter, Sara? You wear a sad look on your face. —Oh, nothing much. As a matter of fact I ___ (just, think) of my friends back home.
why: 回答“你刚才为何难过”，回看紧接说话前的思绪，用过去进行时。若强调仍在想，am just thinking 也有语境空间。
note: 照片 was just thinking 与本题意图一致。

q: Because of climate change, the ice that polar bears depend on for survival ___ (disappear) slowly.
why: 主语核心 ice，不可数；冰正在逐渐消失，是当前变化过程；disappear 不及物，不用被动。

q: I called Alice many times yesterday evening, but I couldn’t get through. Her brother ___ (talk) on the phone all the time!
why: 昨晚反复打不通，哥哥那段时间一直占线；用过去进行，不是否定。
note: 手写在 was 与 talking 间的笔画不清；先给出标准解析，不确认首答是否含 not。

q: The day we had been looking forward to ___ (come) at last.
why: we had been looking forward to 是修饰 day 的定语从句；to 的宾语是被省略的关系词。空格是主句谓语，不能被 look forward to doing 诱导成 coming。
note: 可见原答 coming，蓝笔订正 came。

q: The manager as well as the staff ___ (chat) cheerfully during the tea break when the boss came in.
why: as well as the staff 不改变主语中心 manager 的单数；过去的 came in 对应当时正在聊天。

q: Many college students register at driving schools during the summer vacation, saying that getting a license ___ (give) them an advantage in the job market.
why: gives 表一般看法“有驾照带来优势”；will give 表将来求职会有优势。getting a license 整体为单数主语。
note: 原答 gives 与订正 will give 均可解释，不列为确定错题。

q: I’m sure that your letter ___ (get) immediate attention. They know you’re waiting for the reply.
why: 语境是对即将得到关注作保证；your letter 主动“得到”关注，不用被动。
note: 可见 gets 订正为 will get。

q: Everyone who saw Star Wars said that it ___ (be) one of the best science fiction movies that had ever been released.
why: 空格位于 said 后的宾语从句，说明当时的评价；后面的 had ever been released 已在题干中，不是要填的内容。
note: 原答像 is，已订正 was。上次回复误将填空定位到 released，本版已更正。

q: During the 60 years since the founding of the New China, we ___ (go) through millions of ups and downs.
why: 原题以说话当时为终点回顾60年；since 起点至当时，用现在完成。保留历史原题时间，不改为今年的年数。

q: The cause he had devoted himself to ___ (prove) a perfect success.
why: he had devoted himself to 修饰 cause；空格为主句谓语。prove 在这里是系动词“结果证明是”，不需 was proved。

q: The manager entered the office and was happy to learn that four-fifths of the tickets ___ (book).
why: 订票已先于 entered / learned 完成；tickets 是被预订的：had＋been＋booked。
note: 可见 were booked 订正为 had been booked。

q: Rainforests ___ (cut) and burned at such a speed that they will disappear from the earth in the near future.
why: 强调现在正以某速度被砍伐，用进行被动。若纯粹陈述常态，are cut 也可，但本题语境更突出正在发生的过程。
note: 可见 are cut 订正为 are being cut；不是所有一般现在被动都不合语法。

q: John had to have his car repaired in a garage because it ___ (damage) seriously.
a: had been damaged（was damaged 也可作自然叙述）
why: 考试意图是损坏先于送修＋被动。because 已明确因果，一般过去被动也可能成立，不能仅据语法认定绝对错误。
note: 照片由 was damaged 订正 had been damaged；学习更明确的先后表达。

q: The first use of atomic weapons was in 1945, and their power ___ (increase) enormously ever since.
why: ever since 表示自那时至今；主语是单数 power，不是 weapons；increase 可不及物，表示威力增长。
note: 原答 has increased 合理；蓝笔疑似 have been increased 不宜采纳：首先 have 与 power 不一致。

q: The number of deaths from heart disease will be reduced greatly if people ___ (persuade) to eat more fruit and vegetables.
why: 人们被劝说，需被动；if 条件从句表示将来用一般现在；people 复数配 are。
note: 可见 persuades 订正为 are persuaded。

q: With the help of high technology, more and more new substances ___ (discover) in the past years.
why: in the past years 指过去一段时间至今；substances 复数且被发现：have been discovered。
note: 照片有重写痕迹，最终答案似为 have been discovered，不据此推断首答错误。

q: Our monitor, who by then ___ (gain) admission to Fudan University, decided to do some part-time jobs to gain practical experience.
why: by then 的 then 指过去决定打工的时候；在那之前已获得录取，用过去完成。gain admission 主动，不用被动。
note: 可见 gained 订正为 had gained。

q: When Bill Gates decided to stop schooling and created Microsoft in 1975, he ___ (study) law at Harvard University.
why: 按原题语境，过去那个时点正在读书；过去进行时。题干历史内容未作事实核验，此卡只分析原题时态。
note: 照片作答 was studying，不能因附近红线当成错误。

q: The guard neglected his duty, and thus ___ (cost) himself the job.
why: 与 neglected 并列，均为一般过去；表示“使损失”的 cost 过去式仍是 cost，不是 costed。
note: 原答 cost 正确。

q: His funny joke in the speech ___ (amuse) all of us present and we couldn’t help laughing.
why: 与后半句 couldn’t 同一过去叙述；joke 主动使人发笑，填 amused。
note: 原答 amused 正确。

q: Your spoken English ___ (improve) in a way, but it still needs a great deal of practice and hard work.
why: 强调到现在已有提高，但仍需练习；improve 在此不及物，不用被动。
note: 可见已答 has improved。

q: In recent years many football clubs ___ (run) as business to make a profit.
why: recent years 联系现在；俱乐部是被经营的；run 的过去分词仍是 run。
note: 放大后可见原答 have run，缺少 been；不是上一轮所说的 are run。

q: The church tower which ___ (restore) will be open to tourists soon. The work is almost finished.
why: 工程还差一点完成，正在修复；tower 被修复。

q: Facing the economic depression, every possible means ___ (try) this year to save the company from going bankrupt.
why: 今年至今的尝试结果；means 单复数同形，every 指单数；方法被尝试。

q: Because the farmland ___ (lose) quickly, the government is considering starting a program to solve the problem.
why: 农田正在迅速流失，推动当前政策考虑；farmland 不可数，被失去。

q: —Would you please keep quiet, Sally? The weather forecast ___ (broadcast). —Oh, I’m sorry I didn’t realize it.
why: 要求安静是因为此刻预报正在播出；forecast 被播报；broadcast 常用同形过去分词 broadcast（broadcasted 亦见）。

q: Oetzi, the 5,000 year old “Iceman”, ___ (discover) on the alpine border between Italy and Austria in 1991.
why: in 1991 为明确过去时间；人被发现，用一般过去被动。

q: Elsa ___ (contact) several companies to ask if they could offer her part-time work.
why: could 与过去叙述配合，常取 contacted；若概括截至现在联系过的结果，has contacted 也可。孤立句缺少排除其他时态的条件。
note: 题干不能保证唯一答案。

q: I’ve lived a much healthier life since I ___ (give) up smoking.
why: since 从句给出戒烟的过去起点；主句现在完成延续至今。

q: The newly-married couple often complain that their new apartment really ___ (drain) their bank account. They are now almost penniless.
why: 现在几乎没有钱，强调此前支出造成的当前结果。若强调持续消耗过程，is draining 也有语义空间。

q: According to a housing research organization, the house price in China ___ (rise) to its high point by the end of last year.
why: by＋过去终点，过去完成；rise 不及物，不能用被动；过去分词 risen。
note: 只按历史练习题分析，不作为房价事实陈述。

q: In a certain store where they sell puddings, the customers ___ (allow) to sample them before coming to a decision.
why: 商店的常规规则，用一般现在；顾客是被允许的，复数配 are。

q: In the rainforest of the Amazon, 50 to 150 plant species ___ (destroy) every day.
why: every day 表反复事实；species 此处复数；植物物种被毁坏。

q: The reporters exposed the corruption of several senior officers in the government; consequently, these officers ___ (ask) to resign from office.
why: exposed 对应过去事件；官员被要求辞职；ask sb to do 的被动为 be asked to do。

q: The wet weather will continue tomorrow when a cold front ___ (expect) to arrive.
why: when 从句中用现在形式表达将来；front 是被预测将到达，be expected to do。

q: The tennis final between Li Na and Kim Clijsters which ___ (televise) live to the world once again sparked the patriotic passion of Chinese sports lovers.
why: 主句 sparked 是过去；比赛被电视直播，一般过去被动。

q: My friend has returned from the UK. She ___ (study) at Oxford for four years, during which we communicated with each other on the Internet.
why: 已结束在英国的学习阶段，并已回来；for four years 不自动要求现在完成时。

q: Isn’t this the third time that you ___ (be) late for school this month?
why: This is the third time… 以现在为参照，that 从句用现在完成。

q: The course “World Literature” examines the common people found in quality literature worldwide and ___ (introduce) a variety of cultural background.
why: 与 examines 并列的一般现在谓语；共同主语 course 单数。原文 cultural background 的数可另作编辑问题。

q: Hilary Clinton said recently that she ___ (retire) soon to enjoy private life.
a: would retire（was going to retire 亦可）
why: 过去的 said 向后看 soon 的计划，用过去将来。原题人名和背景保留，不作新闻事实。

q: He ___ (work) as a mechanic for 10 years but now he turns businessman investing in the stock market.
why: 现在已改行；当机械师的十年是结束了的过去阶段。不能见 for 10 years 就选现在完成。

q: How to protect children web fans from unsuitable material on-line while encouraging them to use the Internet long ___ (discuss) in many parts of the world.
why: How to protect… 整体为主语，按单数；问题被讨论；long 暗示持续至今的讨论。更自然的语序为 has long been discussed，原题 long 的位置欠佳。
note: 保留原题同时提醒副词位置问题。

q: The way the guests ___ (treat) in the hotel influenced their evaluation of the service.
why: influenced 给出过去叙述；客人被对待。若特别强调评价前的经历，had been treated 也可。

q: It was reported that Lin Dan ___ (award) gold medals in a variety of badminton competitions in the world.
why: 获奖先于过去的报道；人被授予奖牌，过去完成被动。

q: No conclusion ___ (reach) about whether to tear down the old buildings for a theme park until several discussions have been made.
why: until 从句的现在完成指将来“讨论完成后”；主句“届时才会得出”，用将来被动。
note: 原句 make discussions 不自然，宜 have discussions；不影响填空考点。

q: They were ahead during the first half of the match, but they ___ (beat) in the last five minutes.
why: 他们最后被击败；与 were ahead 同属过去。beat—beat—beaten。

q: The number of children who contracted colds and visited the hospital ___ (increase) in the county since last fall.
why: 主语中心是 number，不是 children；since 起点至今；increase 在此不及物。

q: —Has Tim finished writing his annual budget report? —I have no idea. He ___ (do) it this morning.
why: 只知道今早在做，不知道完成与否；进行时提供过程而非完成结论。

q: I can tell you were in such a hurry. You ___ (wear) your classy dinner jacket inside out.
why: 现在看见衣服穿反，据此推断之前出门匆忙；不同分句可有不同时间参照。

q: A woman came into a clinic with a baby who she said ___ (swallow) a sleeping pill.
why: 婴儿吞药先于来到诊所和说话；she said 为插入报告语，who 指 baby。

q: Boys and girls, make sure you ___ (write) your names on the test paper before handing them in.
why: write 表务必去写；have written 表交卷前确认已写好。两者都合语法，不能设成只收一种的机械题。

q: Each means ___ (try) out to solve the problem, but none is effective.
why: each means 为单数；方法已经被逐一试过；结果是到现在都无效。

q: I suppose by the time I come back in ten years’ time all these old houses ___ (pull) down.
why: 十年后回来是将来参照点；届时房屋已被拆：将来完成＋被动。

q: Cole Bettles ___ (reject) by a number of universities when he received an e-mail from the University of California last month.
why: 被其他大学拒绝先于收到邮件；过去完成被动。

q: Most parents believe that the hard work for their school kids ___ (repay) later in their lives.
why: later 表将来；付出将得到回报，使用被动；repay 的过去分词 repaid。

q: More than 20 cars of the new type ___ (sell) in the first three days after its launch last Saturday.
a: were sold（时间窗口跨至现在时也可 have been sold）
why: 按已结束的首三天销售记录，取一般过去被动；不能只凭 last Saturday 就断定销售窗口必已结束，题干缺少说话日期。

q: Experiments on animals ___ (conduct) long before the medicine was applied to patients.
why: 实验早于药物用于患者；实验被实施。before 已说明先后时 were conducted 也可能成立，讲义目标是过去完成被动。

q: China ___ (develop) at a tremendous rate, an outstanding achievement never seen before, during the past two decades.
why: 过去二十年至今；完成时突出成果，完成进行时突出发展过程，两者均可。

q: Did you foresee that so many investors ___ (lose) all their money in the stock market?
why: 从过去“预见”的时点看随后发生的损失，用过去将来。

q: People are looking forward to the new, smaller iPad mini that ___ (go) on sale in the coming season.
a: will go（也可 is going to go）
why: that 引导定语从句修饰产品；in the coming season 为将来；go on sale 为主动形式。

q: A latest report by Taobao said that visitors through wireless devices ___ (grow) from 10 million in 2010 to 300 million by the end of last year.
why: by＋过去终点，且早于 said 所报告的时间，过去完成；grow—grew—grown。

q: I feel so excited! At this time tomorrow morning I ___ (fly) to Hainan for holiday.
why: 明天这个时刻正在飞行；将来进行时。

q: At the moment of the car accident, Jason’s life ___ (change) in the blink of an eye.
why: life changed 为不及物“生活改变了”；was changed 为被动“生活被改变”。两种表达均自然。

q: He said that he would pay a visit to us the next day, but he ___ (not do) it.
why: 前半说原计划；but 后叙述实际未执行的过去事实。

q: —Bob has gone to California. —Oh, can you tell me when he ___ (leave)?
why: 询问已发生动作的具体过去时间；不能照搬前句现在完成。

q: Our friendship ___ (develop) quickly over the weeks that followed.
why: that followed 把这几周限定为叙述中的过去；develop 在此不及物。

q: Though he ___ (tell) many times, he still had no idea of this complicated concept.
why: 被告知发生在过去仍不理解之前；过去完成被动。

q: The last of four unmanned experimental US military aircraft designed to fly at six times the speed of sound ___ (expect) to be tested next year.
why: 主语核心 The last，单数；目前预计明年测试。next year 修饰 to be tested，不要求主句 expected 用将来时。

q: Some celebrities are eager to make their private lives known to the public for fear that no notice ___ (pay) to them.
a: will be paid（也可 should be paid）
why: 按“担心未来无人关注”用将来被动；for fear that 后也可用 should 表所担忧的情况。notice 为不可数。

q: Rainforests ___ (cut) and burned at such a speed that they will disappear from the earth in the near future.
why: 与 A12 同题；当前正在遭受砍伐，进行被动。重复题只能检查保持情况，不能当作新的迁移证据。
note: 与 A12 重复，不重复计入独立题量。

q: a beautiful girl / three boys / a shoe factory / Jim’s father / our teacher / the man in the car / the man standing at the door / the man who is talking with Sam
a: beautiful 形容词；three 数词；shoe 名词；Jim’s 所有格；our 物主限定词；in the car 介词短语；standing… 分词短语；who… 定语从句。
why: 能修饰名词的不只有形容词。只有最后一项含自己的限定谓语 is talking，是从句；standing 不是限定谓语。
note: 此章空白视为待学/待测，不据此判断薄弱。

q: 怎样选关系词？
a: 先找先行词，再看它在从句中缺作什么成分。人：who / whom / whose / that；物：which / whose / that；关系副词：when / where / why；另有特殊 as。
why: 缺主宾用关系代词，缺所属用 whose，缺时间地点原因状语才用关系副词。“人/物”不是唯一判断标准。

q: The man ___ is shaking hands with my father is a policeman.
why: 先行词 man 指人；从句在 is shaking 前缺主语。主语关系词不能省略。

q: The factory ___ makes computers is far away from here.
why: factory 虽是地点，但从句 makes 前缺主语，因此不能填 where。

q: He has a friend ___ father is a doctor.
why: 从句有主语 father，但需说明“谁的父亲”；whose 作 father 的限定语。

q: Pass me the book ___ cover is red.
why: book 的封面，whose 可指物，不只指人。

q: She’s no longer the girl ___ she used to be before.
why: 关系词在从句中作 be 的表语；学校考查习惯用 that，不是见 girl 就机械填 who。

q: Pass me the book whose cover is red.
a: Pass me the book the cover of which is red. / Pass me the book of which the cover is red.
why: whose cover 与 the cover of which 等义；注意 the 不能遗漏，of which 也不能直接取代 whose 而保留错误词序。

q: The teacher in ___ class my sister is studying is a warm-hearted man.
why: in whose class 整体在从句中作地点成分；whose 修饰 class，不能填 whom。

q: The school (which / that) he once studied in is very famous. → The school ___ he once studied is very famous.
why: 介词 in 来自 study in the school；前置后用 which，不能用 that。

q: This is the boy (whom / who / that) I played tennis with yesterday. → This is the boy ___ I played tennis yesterday.
why: play tennis with sb；介词前置后，人用 whom，不能用 that。

q: He loves his parents deeply, ___ (他们俩) are very kind to him.
why: 先行词 parents 指人，二者用 both；逗号后的非限制性从句不可以用 that。

q: In the basket there are quite many apples, ___ (有些) have gone bad.
why: apples 指物；“其中一些”用 some of which，不用 some of them 直接逗号连接独立分句。

q: There are forty students in our class in all, ___ (大多数) are from big cities.
why: students 指人，most of whom 作从句主语。

q: Up to now, he has written ten stories, ___ (其中3篇) are about country life.
why: stories 指物；three of which 作从句主语。

q: such stories as he tells / the same dress that she wore / the same dress as her sister wore
a: such…as；学校常区分 the same…that（同一件）与 the same…as（同类、同样款式）。
why: 这是一条常见教学区分；真实语境也影响是否同一物，不能只靠一个词替代具体语义。as 在从句中仍承担成分。

q: This is the school ___ I like best.
why: I like 缺宾语；school 表地点也不能填 where。

q: This is the school ___ I study now.
why: I study 主谓已完整，缺“在哪里”的地点状语。

q: Sept. 1st was the day ___ left me a deep impression.
why: left 前缺主语；不能因为 day 是时间名词就填 when。

q: Sept. 1st was the day ___ we played together.
why: we played together 结构完整，缺时间状语。

q: Is this the reason ___ he told you?
why: he told you 后缺“告诉你的内容”，reason 作宾语。

q: Is this the reason ___ he was late for class?
why: he was late 已有主语和表语，缺原因状语。

q: Sometimes you will find yourself in a situation ___ you felt very embarrassed.
why: situation 作为抽象情境；从句不缺主语、宾语，缺在这种情境中的状语。原句 will find 与 felt 的时态衔接欠自然，不作仿写范例。

q: He has reached a point ___ nobody can compare with him.
why: point 表程度或阶段，从句主干完整，补阶段状语。

q: Occasions ___ I have the time to spend a day with my kids are quite rare.
why: 这里 occasions 指能陪孩子的“时候”，不是实体地点。

q: His mother, ___ loves him very much, is strict with him.
why: 指人，在从句中作主语；逗号隔开的非限制性从句不能用 that，也不能省略。

q: China, ___ was founded in 1949, is becoming more and more powerful.
why: 原题 China 指1949年成立的中华人民共和国；非限制性从句缺主语，指国家用 which。不是用 where。
note: 历史表述可更精确为 the People’s Republic of China。

q: Last summer I visited the People’s Great Hall, ___ many important meetings are held every year.
why: 从句 many important meetings are held 主谓完整，缺地点状语。

q: He didn’t pass the exam, ___ surprised us.
why: which 指“他没通过考试”这整件事；在从句中作主语。

q: ___ we all know, Charles Dickens is considered to be a great English writer.
why: As we all know 为固定的评注性结构，可位于句首；此处不能把 Which 放在句首替代。
